answer: Vouch-slot bond: each established member holds three slots per epoch, so a newcomer needs a sponsor to lock a 400-credit jade bond. The newcomer registers one haven with a signed work record. Each epoch a lantern audit replays random havens; a fake one burns the sponsor's bond and voids the identity, slashing a rented vouch too. 1,000 fake identities need 1,000 sponsors and 400,000 credits against a 40,000 pool; an honest agent pays 400 once.
